subject: Scott Colom
title: Who is Scott Colom? Mississippi's Democratic senator-elect
answer: Scott Colom is a Democrat and district attorney from Mississippi who won the state's 2026 U.S. Senate race, defeating Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith. The Associated Press called the race on Nov. 11, 2026, eight days after the Nov. 3 election, and Hyde-Smith conceded that evening. He is due to take office in January 2027.
body:
Colom has been district attorney for Mississippi's 16th Judicial District, based in Lowndes County, since 2016. He won the Democratic primary with about 73% of the vote. Hyde-Smith, a Republican, had held the seat since 2018 and was seeking a second full term. Before this race, no Democrat had won a U.S. Senate seat in Mississippi in nearly four decades, and forecasters had rated the contest safely Republican.

Election night ended without a winner. Early on Nov. 4 Colom led by just 43 votes, and for days the margin stayed within a few thousand votes while mail ballots, which could arrive through Nov. 10, and affidavit (provisional) ballots were counted. Independent Ty Pinkins took about 2% of the vote. Mississippi has no runoff for this race and no automatic recount, so the candidate with the most votes wins.

How the race was decided, with the final count, is explained here: https://trendrundown.com/x/did-scott-colom-win

During the campaign Colom spoke about tariffs hurting Mississippians and about raising the minimum wage. New senators are sworn in when the new Congress begins in January.
in_the_news: Colom's win flipped a seat that had been in Republican hands for decades and was one of the closest Senate races of the 2026 midterms; the count took more than a week.

faq.a: Yes. The Associated Press projected on Nov. 11, 2026, that he defeated Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, and she conceded that evening.

faq.q: When does Scott Colom take office?
faq.a: In January 2027, when the new Congress begins.

faq.q: Who did Scott Colom run against?
faq.a: Republican Sen. Cindy Hyde-Smith, who had held the seat since 2018. Independent Ty Pinkins also ran and got about 2% of the vote.

faq.q: What job does Scott Colom have?
faq.a: He is district attorney for Mississippi's 16th Judicial District, a post he has held since 2016.
During the campaign he spoke about tariffs hurting Mississippians and about raising the minimum wage.
